description: Illustration: symbolic result plus a hypothetical planned empirical study; nothing executed.

research_object.scope: Symbolic masking and a separate hypothetical empirical activation-distribution question

assumptions: same hidden vector h in both paths
derivations.implication: No GPU experiment is required to verify this identity.

hypotheses.mechanism: Output error changes with W and data-dependent hidden-channel covariance.
hypotheses.prediction: Joint structure of hidden activations and downstream projection will be more informative than activation magnitude alone.

experiments.question: Does real activation/projection alignment explain observed errors better than activation magnitude alone?
experiments.empirical_quantity: Activation and error distributions under actual workloads
experiments.why_not_derivable: Requires the unknown input distribution and actual checkpoint activations
controls: Same tokens, model weights and masks across comparators

predictions.decision: Study cancellation and alignment as a mechanism

predictions.outcome: Joint metric does not separate cases
predictions.decision: Reconsider candidate mechanism; inspect downstream state sensitivity

experiments.cost_estimate: Minimal activation trace, not full video generation

decisions.reason: The exact algebra is resolved; the remaining dataset-dependent property is not.

goal_contract.scientific_question: For a fixed symbolic masked projection, which data-dependent output geometry predicts local error under equal budget?

terminal_criteria.requirement: Determine whether measured candidate improvement transfers to a genuinely independent output-error comparator
terminal_criteria.comparator: Same projection, masks, evaluation split and count of retained coordinates
terminal_criteria.verification: Registered full-output error on independent data, not merely proxy ranking

proxy_metrics.why_not_terminal: It omits downstream W and cancellation and is only a selection diagnostic
proxy_metrics.bridge_test: Recompute full-output error for equal-budget masks with fixed W

hard_constraints: Do not claim a run from this illustrative, planned-only example

research_moves.structural_delta: Compare weight-aware joint output contributions against magnitude-only selection at equal mask count; not more magnitude-threshold tuning

competing_mechanisms.prediction: Equal-magnitude masks exhibit different W-weighted output errors
competing_mechanisms.decision_if_supported: Inspect joint signed structure and formulate a deployability bound

competing_mechanisms.mechanism: Magnitude suffices for this data regime
competing_mechanisms.prediction: Equal-magnitude masks have indistinguishable W-weighted output error distributions
competing_mechanisms.decision_if_supported: Keep magnitude as a baseline and test other structural axes

research_moves.cheapest_discriminator: Symbolic counterexample first, then one hypothetical paired small activation trace if required
research_moves.negative_outcome_decision: Do not promote the proxy; reassess representation without changing terminal comparator

exploration_seeds.question: Can cancellation among signed output contributions change which channels are worth retaining?
exploration_seeds.possible_mechanism: Equal activation norms can lead to different output cancellation if projection directions differ.
assumptions: Symbolic linear projection with signed contributions
exploration_seeds.possible_falsifier: A restricted projection class where contribution vectors are mutually orthogonal or identical in sign

exploration_seeds.question: Can a different output basis expose a cheaper support operation?
exploration_seeds.possible_mechanism: Represent the projection with a shared subspace and a small residual only where structural alignment warrants it.

exploration_seeds.question: Can an earlier observable correlate with the expensive output-coordinate decision?
exploration_seeds.possible_mechanism: A low-cost statistic computed before the projection could predict when a subset matters; oracle post-projection scores may not be deployable.

exploration_seeds.question: When does an abstract logical support map onto actual skipped machine work?
exploration_seeds.possible_mechanism: The relationship may be controlled by tile geometry and packing cost rather than logical zero fraction.
